The NAGPRA Registration Supervisor exists to ensure that UC Berkeley's repatriation registration work is accurate, consistent, and completed on time. Reporting within the NAGPRA Repatriation Team under the Office of the Chancellor, this position oversees the daily technical, registration, and data operations of the repatriation team and directly manages three Assistant Registrars (NAGPRA) across regional consultation teams.
Directly manage, support, and evaluate three Assistant Registrars (NAGPRA). - 30%

The NAGPRA Registration Supervisor ensures the campus meets all federal and state compliance deadlines under NAGPRA and CalNAGPRA, including the December 2028 deadline for inventories and Notices of Inventory Completion. The position reviews and approves draft notices before submission, oversees the documentation of Tribal outreach and consultation, and maintains the accuracy, security, and integrity of repatriation records in CSpace and Consultation Manager. Working closely with NAGPRA Liaisons, collections managers, and NAGPRA leadership, the position upholds documentation rigor, Tribal data sovereignty principles, and respectful care across all regional repatriation projects.
Delegate regional project portfolios, set priorities, monitor progress, and balance Assistant's workloads across consultation teams.
Conduct performance reviews, establish individual goals, and provide onboarding and ongoing professional development for direct reports.
Establish unified protocol standards for data entry, registration procedures, and tribal correspondence integration.
Oversee compliance timelines and reporting workflows across all three Assistant Registrar portfolios to ensure federal and state deadlines (including 2028 targets) are met. - 25%
Review and approve draft Notice of Inventory Completion (NIC) and Notice of Intent to Repatriate (NIR) documents prior to official submission.
Coordinate inter-agency and inter-campus compliance efforts for complex collections involving federal, state, and other repository agreements.
Supervise the creation and logging of Tribal outreach documentation, Outreach Cultural/Regional Groupings, and consultation notes. - 20%
Assist NAGPRA Liaisons and Assistant Registrars in preparing comprehensive synthesis reports on former consultations, notices, and repatriation requests.
Attend high-level consultation visits and inter-tribal working meetings as appropriate.
Oversee CSpace and Consultation Manager data entry, ensuring data accuracy, security, and alignment with Tribal data sovereignty standards. - 20%
Perform regular audits of CSpace registration records, claim logs, and duty of care tracking.
Coordinate with the Provenance team in physical and digital archival digitization initiatives across all repatriation projects.
Maintain expertise in evolving NAGPRA/CalNAGPRA statutory requirements, national registration standards, and Tribal relations policies. - 5%
Attend professional forums and statewide/national working groups.
Research and present data management tools to leadership to increase efficiency and communication.
Advanced knowledge of NAGPRA and CalNAGPRA regulations, compliance workflows, and repatriation practices
Proven ability to manage complex multi-project timelines, delegate effectively, and enforce quality control across large datasets.
Strong analytical, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to summarize complex data for diverse campus and tribal stakeholders.
